title: After Mint Infused Tobacco | The Tobacconist by Cuttwood E Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
After Mint Infused Tobacco 100ml Short Fill:
Discover the ultimate blend of refinement and refreshment with After Mint Infused Tobacco by The Tobacconist from Cuttwood. This luxurious e-liquid pairs the deep, smoky tones of rich tobacco with a crisp, invigorating burst of cool mint. Enhanced with a subtle chocolate sweetness, this flavour offers a decadent twist on traditional tobacco blends. Perfectly balanced to deliver a smooth, comforting inhale with a refreshing exhale, this sophisticated combination is both bold and indulgent.
American e-liquid experts Cuttwood have introduced their Tobacconist range of shortfill liquids, featuring six distinct tobacco profiles. Each blend is crafted with precision, delivering unique and satisfying flavours that are sure to impress enthusiasts of premium tobacco e-liquids.
Product Features
Brand:
Cuttwood
Brand Origin:
USA
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine shot have been added – Tap here for our nic shot calculator.)
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
